raw_text: MarineTraffic has confirmed that the vehicle carrier MV Galaxy Leader (IMO 9237307) ceased transmitting AIS data at approximately 0545 UTC on November 19 in the southern Red Sea. The vessel's last known position was approximately 60 nautical miles west of Al Hudaydah, Yemen. The Galaxy Leader is a 2002-built Ro-Ro vehicle carrier flagged in the Bahamas and linked to an Israeli businessman through a chain of corporate ownership. We are monitoring the situation and will update as more information becomes available.
